project.name: Zombie Apocalypse
project.description: A Godot 4 2D platformer where players use Robot and Ninja characters to stop a zombie apocalypse. Features generic base scripts for characters, bullets, levels, and tweens.

nodes.name: lint-paths.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs on push and pull_request to reject any tracked file containing absolute home-directory paths (e.g. /home/<user>/ or C:\Users\). Excludes Markdown files and the openspec/ directory from the check.

nodes.name: Bug Report Template
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for reporting bugs. Prompts users for a description, reproduction steps, expected behaviour, screenshots, and platform/device information.

nodes.name: Feature Request Template
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for feature requests. Asks for the problem being solved, desired solution, alternatives considered, and additional context.

nodes.name: New Development Request Template
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for new development work. Prompts for a description of the new development, additional context, and impact on existing features.

nodes.name: .gitignore
nodes.summary: Git ignore rules for the Godot 4 project. Excludes Godot-specific build artifacts (.godot/, export_presets.cfg), Mono files, temporary files, and workspace-orchestrator managed entries.

nodes.name: .pre-commit-config.yaml
nodes.summary: Pre-commit hook configuration that uses pygrep to reject commits containing absolute home-directory paths. Complements the CI workflow lint-paths.yml.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Instructions for AI agents (Hermes, Copilot, Codex, etc.) on how to orient themselves in the repository. Documents available graph tools: graphify, understand-anything, and codegraph, along with their recommended usage order.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: High-level changelog tracking released plugin versions. Currently documents v0.1 (initial asset library publish, scene tree browsing) and v0.2 (inspector integration, F12 node selection).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Main project documentation for Zombie Apocalypse, a Godot 4 2D platformer. Covers requirements, Godot 3-to-4 migration notes, and full keyboard controls for Robot and Male Ninja characters.

nodes.name: export_presets.cfg
nodes.summary: Godot export preset configuration defining Linux/X11 and Windows Desktop export targets with texture format and architecture settings. Export paths are empty (previously leaked absolute home-directory paths, now cleared).

nodes.name: project.godot
nodes.summary: Godot 4 engine configuration file (config_version=5) for the Retro_Apocalyse project. Defines the main scene (World_Scene.tscn), display settings (1280x800), all input action bindings, and rendering quality settings.

nodes.name: .openspec.yaml (issue-5)

nodes.name: Proposal: Remove Hardcoded Paths (issue-5)
nodes.summary: Detailed proposal for removing hardcoded absolute home-directory paths from export_presets.cfg that were leaking developer username and Dropbox folder structure. Covers four issues: clearing both export paths, creating .gitignore, adding CI lint workflow, and adding a pre-commit hook.

nodes.name: Spec Approved (issue-5)

nodes.name: Tasks: Remove Hardcoded Paths (issue-5)

nodes.name: .openspec.yaml (issue-7)

nodes.name: Proposal: Enforce GDScript Naming Conventions (issue-7)
nodes.summary: Comprehensive proposal to rename all camelCase identifiers to snake_case across four GDScript files (generic_character_behaviour.gd, generic_bullet_behaviour.gd, generic_tween_script.gd, generic_level_script.gd), fix five comment typos, standardise signal names, and add gdtoolkit CI enforcement.

nodes.name: Ammo_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Collectible ammo power-up scene that randomly grants 5, 10, or 15 bullets to the player character on contact. Displays a bullet image and count label, adapting texture to the current character type.

nodes.name: Blood_Particle_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Particle effect scene that emits a one-shot blood splatter using Particles2D and a blood texture. Automatically frees itself once the emission finishes.

nodes.name: Energy_Stone_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Collectible energy power-up that restores a random percentage (15%, 20%, or 35%) of the character's max energy on contact. Uses a power gem sprite and proximity Area2D detection.

nodes.name: Health_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Collectible health power-up that restores a random percentage (15%, 20%, 35%, or 40%) of the character's max health when picked up. Uses a health sprite with Area2D collision.

nodes.name: World_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Root world/game manager scene that orchestrates level loading, character selection (Robot, Ninja male/female), HUD updates, and game flow including level progression. Contains the CanvasLayer HUD with health, energy, ammo indicators and a PopupPanel.

nodes.name: default_env.tres
nodes.summary: Godot Environment resource defining a procedural sky background with blue sky, horizon, and ground colours. Used as the default world environment for the game scenes.

nodes.name: Bullet_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Robot character's bullet projectile scene with a 5-frame animated sprite (CharacterBody2D). Extends generic_bullet_behaviour.gd and spawns a Muzzle_Scene effect on creation; frees itself when it leaves the screen.

nodes.name: Character_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Playable Robot character scene (CharacterBody2D) with full animation set (idle, run, jump, shoot, melee, slide, dead) for male variant. Extends generic_character_behaviour.gd, handles player input, shooting, melee, and slide attacks.

nodes.name: Muzzle_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Muzzle flash effect scene using an AnimatedSprite2D with a 5-frame animation. Auto-plays and frees itself after the animation completes one cycle.

nodes.name: Enemy_Saw_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Environmental hazard scene: a rotating saw blade (StaticBody2D) that damages characters on contact and can be destroyed by high-power bullets. Uses a Tween for movement via generic_tween_script.gd, emitting a touchedSaw signal.

nodes.name: Enemy_Zombie_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Zombie enemy character scene (CharacterBody2D) supporting male and female variants with full animation sets (idle, walk, attack, dead). Extends generic_character_behaviour.gd with AI that chases the player and avoids saws and barriers.

nodes.name: Enemy_barrier.tscn
nodes.summary: Invisible barrier Node2D used to turn zombie enemies around at level boundaries. Emits a touchedBarrier signal when an enemy_character body enters its Area2D collision zone.

nodes.name: Bone_Scene.tscn
nodes.summary: Environment scene representing a bone object dropped when an enemy character dies. Instantiated by generic_character_behaviour.gd on non-main character death.

nodes.name: generic_bullet_behaviour.gd
nodes.summary: Base bullet class extending CharacterBody2D. Handles projectile movement, collision detection, brick destruction, enemy damage, and visual scaling based on power level.

nodes.name: _animate_bullet
nodes.summary: Main bullet update function called each frame. Sets speed, plays animation, scales by power level, moves the bullet, checks collisions, and frees bullet on invalid collision.

nodes.name: _set_speed
nodes.summary: Calculates and sets the bullet's x-axis velocity based on speed, delta time, and movement direction.

nodes.name: _create_muzzle
nodes.summary: Instantiates a muzzle flash scene and positions it relative to the bullet's origin direction, then adds it to the scene tree.

nodes.name: _animate
nodes.summary: Plays the bullet sprite animation.

nodes.name: _remove_if_brick
nodes.summary: Checks if the collided object is a brick or power-up brick, calls break_object() on it, and queues the bullet for deletion if its power level is insufficient to pass through.

nodes.name: _check_collision_objects
nodes.summary: Queries the Area2D for overlapping bodies and calls _take_damage on any enemy characters found, then removes the bullet.

nodes.name: generic_character_behaviour.gd
nodes.summary: Base character class extending CharacterBody2D. Manages movement, jumping, health, ammo, energy, damage, animations, timers, and character state (alive/dead/dazed/invincible).

nodes.name: _start_process
nodes.summary: Main character update driver. Calls _animate_player then handles x-axis and y-axis collision via move_and_collide.

nodes.name: _animate_player
nodes.summary: Calculates player speed with gravity, clamps values, updates velocity, controls sprite playback, and delegates to _handle_timers.

nodes.name: _handle_timers
nodes.summary: Manages glide, daze, blood/damage, death, invincibility, and flicker timers each frame. Triggers blood particle effects and damage signals.

nodes.name: _handle_collision
nodes.summary: Resets vertical speed and jump count when the character lands on a surface.

nodes.name: _shoot_bullet
nodes.summary: Instantiates the bullet scene, sets power/damage/direction based on current facing, decrements ammo, and adds the bullet to the scene tree.

nodes.name: _area_checks
nodes.summary: Checks AttackArea2D and CharacterArea2D overlaps to deal melee damage to enemies, break bricks, and receive damage from enemies.

nodes.name: _move_left
nodes.summary: Sets facing and movement direction to left and flips the character sprite horizontally.

nodes.name: _move_right
nodes.summary: Sets facing and movement direction to right and unflips the character sprite.

nodes.name: _take_damage
nodes.summary: Applies damage to the character, deducting from energy first and then health. Sets blood flag and shield indicator as appropriate.

nodes.name: _daze
nodes.summary: Sets the dazed flag to true, temporarily immobilising the character.

nodes.name: _reset_character_sprite_states
nodes.summary: Resets sprite animation and collision state after actions complete or health/daze state changes.

nodes.name: _setup_collision
nodes.summary: Fetches and caches all collision shape node references from the scene tree and sets default collision state.

nodes.name: _default_collision
nodes.summary: Enables the standing collision shape and disables all attack/slide collision shapes, restoring default collision configuration.

nodes.name: _melee_attack_collision
nodes.summary: Enables the directional melee attack collision shape based on current facing direction when action2 is active.

nodes.name: _slide_attack_collision
nodes.summary: Switches to slide collision shapes, disabling standing shapes, to represent the character's slide attack hitbox.

nodes.name: _change_sprite_animation
nodes.summary: Sets the animated sprite's animation by composing the name from gender, type, and animation text.

nodes.name: _take_damage_from_saw
nodes.summary: Signal handler for saw hazard contact. Deals 15 damage to the character if it is the signal's target.

nodes.name: _subscribe_to_signals
nodes.summary: Connects to all enemy saw touchedSaw signals in the scene so the character can receive saw damage.

nodes.name: _emit_reload
nodes.summary: Emits the reload signal for main characters (triggering respawn logic), or drops bones and removes non-main characters from the scene.

nodes.name: _emit_reposition
nodes.summary: Emits the reposition signal for main characters, or removes non-main characters from the scene.

nodes.name: _emit_refresh_hud
nodes.summary: Emits the refresh_hud signal to update the HUD with current character stats, only for main characters.

nodes.name: _emit_character_ready
nodes.summary: Emits the character_ready signal when the character has finished setup, only for main characters.

nodes.name: generic_level_script.gd
nodes.summary: Base level script extending Node2D. Declares exit_level and entered_level signals and emits them on scene tree entry and exit.

nodes.name: _ready
nodes.summary: Called when the level scene enters the tree; emits the entered_level signal.

nodes.name: _exit_tree
nodes.summary: Called when the level scene exits the tree; emits the exit_level signal.

nodes.name: generic_tween_script.gd
nodes.summary: Base tween script extending Node2D. Provides configurable directional tweening for moving objects like floating platforms, with distance, direction, and duration exports.

nodes.name: _start_tween_process
nodes.summary: Starts a tween animation moving the node to movementPosition if tweening is enabled and not already running. Connects the finished signal to _on_tween_completed.

nodes.name: _set_initial_movement
nodes.summary: Calculates and stores the target movement position based on initial position, distance, and direction exports.

nodes.name: _change_x_direction
nodes.summary: Reverses the x movement direction between 1 and -1.

nodes.name: _change_y_direction
nodes.summary: Reverses the y movement direction between 1 and -1.

nodes.name: _on_tween_completed
nodes.summary: Tween finished callback. Reverses both x and y directions and updates movementPosition for the return journey, then resets tweenRunning.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the game: a Godot 4 2D platformer with Robot and Ninja characters fighting zombies.

tour.title: Base Character System
tour.description: The generic_character_behaviour.gd is the foundation — a GDScript base class for all characters (player and enemy alike). It manages health, ammo, movement, jumping, animations, and damage states.

tour.title: Bullet & Projectile System
tour.description: generic_bullet_behaviour.gd extends CharacterBody2D to handle projectile movement, collision detection, and damage. Bullets interact with brick environments and enemy characters.

tour.title: Playable Characters
tour.description: The Robot and Ninja character scenes extend the base character script. The Robot has a muzzle flash, while the Ninja supports double-jump/glide. Each has its own Bullet_Scene.

tour.title: Enemies
tour.description: The Zombie enemy reuses generic_character_behaviour.gd just like players. The Saw uses generic_tween_script.gd for oscillating movement. Enemy_barrier turns zombies around at boundaries.

tour.title: Level Design
tour.description: Level scenes compose environment building blocks: floors, bricks, flora, pits, floats. Level_1 and Level_2 are the main playable stages. The generic_level_script.gd emits enter/exit signals.

tour.title: World Scene & Game Flow
tour.description: World_Scene.tscn is the root scene (set in project.godot). It orchestrates level loading, character selection, and GUI including the PopupPanel.

tour.title: Developer Tooling
tour.description: The project uses openspec for spec-driven change management, codegraph for symbol navigation, pre-commit hooks and CI to prevent hardcoded paths from leaking.
